_scenario.title: Study-Abroad Counsellor
_scenario.persona: Guides students and parents: a scholarship closing tomorrow, a visa file at risk and a parent asking for a refund.

all_tasks.task_details: Go through the UK student visa document checklist
In-office meeting with Mrs. Rokeya and Raisa about the delayed offer letter
Send SOP feedback for the 50% tuition scholarship application
Finalise the college shortlist now that his IELTS score is in
Send the list of German public university programs and blocked account info
Host the parents' seminar on studying in Canada and the UK
Monthly partner call with the university's regional admissions rep

all_followups.followup_details: Check whether the father's bank statement meets the 28-day rule
Call back after the education fair to book a counselling session
Confirm his seat at the parents' seminar (asked if his wife can join)
Chase Northbridge University for Raisa's offer letter
Send the tuition deposit payment guide for the chosen college

all_notes.content: Visa appointment on 10 Dec. UK rules need funds held for 28 days, but his father's statement only shows 12 days at that balance. If the statement fails, the January intake is lost.
Paid our BDT 50,000 service fee. Raisa's offer letter is 6 weeks late and her friend already got an offer through another agency. Mrs. Rokeya is talking about a refund and switching agencies.
Very strong profile (CGPA 3.8, research assistant). Her SOP is too generic for a 50% scholarship - it needs a clear research story. Portal closes 2 Dec, 11:59pm.
IELTS 6.5 overall, 6.0 in writing, so SDS is fine. Prefers Toronto. Family budget around BDT 20 lakh for the first year. Deposit deadline for the January intake is Friday 4 Dec.
Met at the education fair. Interested in tuition-free public universities in Germany, needs blocked account info. Very keen at the fair, no contact since.

all_calls.transcript: Tanjim: Apu, I got my CAS confirmation email. What do I need for the visa appointment on the 10th? Sadia: Congratulations! The main thing is the bank statement - the money has to be held for 28 days in a row. Tanjim: My father moved the money into that account about ten days ago. Is that a problem? Sadia: It might be. Send me the statement and I'll check the dates tonight and tell you tomorrow. Tanjim: Okay. If it's not enough, can we move the appointment? Sadia: We may be able to, I'll check the options for you.

Rokeya: Six weeks! Raisa's friend applied through another agency after us and already has her offer. What exactly are you doing? Sadia: I understand your frustration, Apa, and I'm sorry. I'll chase the university today. Rokeya: You said that last week. We paid fifty thousand taka. If there is no clear answer by tomorrow, I want a refund. Sadia: Please come to the office tomorrow at 12 with Raisa. I'll have a full update from the university by then. Rokeya: Fine. But I want facts, not promises.

Sadia: Priyanka, your profile is excellent. The SOP just reads too general for a scholarship this competitive. Priyanka: What should I change? Sadia: Build it around your research assistant work - the problem, what you did, and why this university's lab. I'll send you detailed line-by-line feedback by Monday. Priyanka: Monday is perfect, that gives me a day to rewrite. The portal closes on the 2nd at midnight. Sadia: We'll make it.

Nafis: Apu, my IELTS result came - 6.5 overall, 6.0 in writing! Sadia: That's enough for SDS, well done. Nafis: Now which college should I pay the deposit to? The deadline is Friday. Sadia: Let's compare the two Toronto colleges on fees and co-op. I'll call you tomorrow at 4 with a clear recommendation. Nafis: My father wants to know the total first-year cost too. Sadia: I'll include that.

Sadia: James, I'm chasing an offer for Raisa Sultana, applied in October. James: Let me look. Ah - her application is on hold. We're still missing the attested copy of her HSC transcript. Sadia: I wasn't told that. James: The email went to the applicant's address, maybe it went to spam. Once we have the attested transcript, the decision usually comes within five working days. Sadia: I'll get it to you this week.

all_messages.subject: SOP feedback?
all_messages.content: Hi Apu, I'm still waiting for the SOP feedback. The scholarship portal closes tomorrow at 11:59pm, so I need it today to have time to rewrite.
We will come at 12 tomorrow. If there is no real update, we will ask for the refund and go to another agency.

all_messages.subject: Father's bank statement
all_messages.content: Apu, the statement is attached. The balance has been there since 18 November. Is that enough for the visa on the 10th?

all_messages.subject: Raisa Sultana - application on hold
all_messages.content: Hi Sadia, as discussed, Raisa's application stays on hold until we receive the attested HSC transcript. Please upload it to the agent portal.
Apu, which college should I pay the deposit to? The deadline is Friday and my father wants to transfer this week.
Can I bring my wife to the seminar on Thursday?

all_messages.subject: Great meeting you at the fair
all_messages.content: Hi Abrar, lovely meeting you at the education fair. Shall we book a free counselling session about Germany?
